# Lab Tools & Resources

<div class="content-panel">
  <p>We share pipelines, protocols, and interactive apps here.</p>
</div>

<div id="tools-grid" class="tools-grid"></div>

<script type="module">
  import { load } from 'https://cdn.skypack.dev/js-yaml@4.1.0';

  async function renderTools() {
    const res = await fetch('_data/tools.yml', { cache: 'no-store' });
    const data = load(await res.text());
    const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.tools || []);
    const container = document.getElementById('tools-grid');

    if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.length) {
      container.innerHTML = '<p>No tools yet.</p>';
      return;
    }

    container.innerHTML = list.map(tool => `
      <article class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-card__header">
          <h3>${tool.name || ''}</h3>
          ${tool.category ? `<span class="pill">${tool.category}</span>` : ''}
        </div>
        <p>${tool.description || ''}</p>
        ${tool.link ? `<p><a href="${tool.link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Learn more</a></p>` : ''}
      </article>
    `).join('');
  }

  renderTools();
</script>
